info.name: UHMS - University Hostel Management System API
info.description:
Full CRUD API collection for the University Hostel Management System (Spring Boot). Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8080 (server.port=8080, no context-path). Auth is JWT Bearer via /api/v1/auth/login. Roles: ADMIN, HOSTEL_STAFF, STUDENT.

Run 'Auth > Login (Admin)' first — it auto-saves the token to the {{adminToken}} collection variable via a test script, and every other request in this collection uses {{adminToken}} by default.

item.name: 1. Auth
Register - Admin (seeded via DataSeeder, usually not needed)

request.description: Roles come from the Role table (seeded: ADMIN, HOSTEL_STAFF, STUDENT). roleName must match exactly.
Seeded default admin: username=admin / password=admin123 (see DataSeeder.java). Auto-saves token to {{adminToken}}.
Requires the 'Register - Hostel Staff' request to have been run first.
Requires the 'Register - Student' request to have been run first.
